items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: That's the gal that got our band into the Empire Room in the Ballman House in Chicago.

ctx.x: Joe Reichman and Connie Haynes. That's the gal that got our band into the Empire Room in the Ballman House in Chicago. No, Connie Haynes. We can thank her for that. That was the only, that was the first jazz band that ever went as an actor.
